c74object.name: evi_approx.genexpr
c74object.digest:
evi_approx.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the "evieve" Package.
It is for using in a codebox or in another .genexpr file via the "require()" command.
By declaring require("evi_approx.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in the evi_approx.genexpr file.
c74object.description: evi_approx.genexpr: Numeric approximations used all over evieve. Approximations are faster than library functions but less accurate. You should be careful using approximations - they can break your code. In evieve all approximations are tested to work on the code in which they are used.

entry.name: cosQ73()
entry.description:
Represents a quarter section of a cosine function, used by subsequent approximations
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..twopi
Return 1: cos, approximated section of a cosine

entry.name: cos73()
entry.description:
Approximated cosine function to 7.3 digits of precision, just about accurate enough for audio
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..twopi
Return 1: cosine, cosine function

entry.name: sin73()
entry.description:
Approximated sine function to 7.3 digits of precision, just about accurate enough for audio
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..twopi
Return 1: sine, sine function

entry.name: cos73param()
entry.description:
Same as 'cos73()' but appropriate for Param rate usage (stays out of while loop)
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..twopi
Return 1: cosine, cosine function

entry.name: sin73param()
entry.description:
Same as 'sin73()' but appropriate for Param rate usage (stays out of while loop)
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..twopi
Return 1: sine, sine function

entry.name: quartParOneApprox()
entry.description:
One quarter of a cosine function, accurate at extremes and half, excellent for crossfading and panning etc
Input 1: type=input: modphase, 0..1
Return 1: cos, cos() portion of ramp (e.g. left multiplier)
Return 2: sin, sin() portion of ramp (e.g. right multiplier)

entry.name: tanA()
entry.description:
Cheapest approximation of 'tan()', useful for BLT
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..1
Return 1: tan, approximated tan() of input

entry.name: tanA2()
entry.description:
More accurate appromimation of 'tan()', useful for BLT with stricter tuning requirements
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..halfpi
Return 1: tan, approximated tan() of input

entry.name: tanA3()
entry.description:
Most accurate appromimation of 'tan()', useful for BLT with very strict tuning requirements
Input 1: type=input: x, -halfpi..halfpi
Return 1: tan, accurate approximated tan() of input

entry.name: atanA()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'arctan()', 2x faster than library, also accurate enough for audio usage
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: arctan, approximated arctan of input

entry.name: atanT()
entry.description:
3rd order approximation of arctan, maximum approximation error 0.00811º
Input 1: type=input: x, 0..infinity
Return 1: arctan, approximated arctan of input

entry.name: atan2Approx()
entry.description:
Famous 'atan2()' approximation, over 2x faster than library
Input 1: type=input: y, float
Input 2: type=input: x, float
Return 1: atan2, approximation of atan2

entry.name: acosT()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'acos()', only useful for very specific scenarios
Input 1: type=input: x, 0.2..1 for accuracy
Return 1: acos, approximated acos of input

entry.name: expP()
entry.description:
Padé approximation of 'exp()', only useful for very specific scenarios, almost 2x faster than library
Input 1: type=input: x, -2..2
Return 1: exp, approximated exp of input

entry.name: expA()
entry.description:
Cheapest full range exp() approximation that evieve offers, we use this everywhere, more accurate than 'fastexp()', at least 1.5 x faster than library exp()
Input 1: type=input: x0, float
Return 1: exp, approximated exp of input

entry.name: expApprox()
entry.description:
Slightly more accurate than 'expA()', about 1.5 x faster than library exp()
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: exp, approximated exp of input

entry.name: pow2Approx()
entry.description:
Approximation of pow(2, input), uses 'expApprox()'
Input 1: type=input: y, float
Return 1: pow2, approximated pow2 of input

entry.name: coshApprox()
entry.description:
Approximated 'cosh()' of input, uses 'expApprox()'
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: cosh, approximated cosh of input

entry.name: log2Approx()
entry.description:
Approximated 'log2()' of input, 1.7 to 2 x faster than library 'log2()'
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: log2, approximated log2 of input

entry.name: logApprox()
entry.description:
Approximated log() of input, uses 'log2Approx()'
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: log, approximated log of input

entry.name: log10Approx()
entry.description:
Approximated log10() of input, uses 'log2Approx()'
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: log10, approximated log10 of input

entry.name: log1pApprox()
entry.description:
Approximated 'log1p()' of input, uses 'log2Approx()'
Input 1: type=input: x, float
Return 1: log1p, approximated log1p

entry.name: transratioApprox()
entry.description:
Transpose semitones input (0=none), like [transratio] and [evi.transratio]
Input 1: type=input: pitch, pitch
Return 1: ratio, ratio

entry.name: mtofApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'mtof()'
Input 1: type=input: pitch, MIDI Pitch
Input 2: type=param (optional): base, default: 440, Hz 415..467
Return 1: frequency, Hz

entry.name: mtofApproxBaseless()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'mtof()'
Input 1: type=input: pitch, MIDI Pitch
Return 1: frequency, Hz

entry.name: mtofApproxAccurate()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'mtof()', most expensive but very accurate accross full range
Input 1: type=input: pitch, MIDI Pitch
Return 1: frequency, Hz

entry.name: ftomApproxBaseless()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'ftom()'
Input 1: type=input: frequency, Hz
Return 1: pitch, MIDI Pitch

entry.name: ftomApproxAccurate()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'ftom()', most expensive but accurate accross full range
Input 1: type=input: frequency, Hz
Return 1: pitch, MIDI Pitch

entry.name: dbtoaApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'dbtoa()'
Input 1: type=input: db, dB
Return 1: a, linear amplitude

entry.name: dbtoaApproxFast()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'dbtoa()', very fast but not very accurate
Input 1: type=input: db, dB
Return 1: a, linear amplitude

entry.name: dbtosqrt2Approx()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'dbtoa(sqrt(input))', useful for filter coefficients
Input 1: type=input: db, dB
Return 1: sqrt, approximated sqrt of amplitude

entry.name: atodbApprox()
entry.description:
Approximated 'atodb()'
Input 1: type=input: amplitude, linear amplitude
Return 1: db, dB

entry.name: tauA()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'exp(-1 / (seconds * samplerate))' for time..pole calculations
Input 1: type=input: t, seconds, > 0.01 for best accuracy
Return 1: exp, exp(-1/samples)

entry.name: hz2barkApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of Hz to Bark coefficients
Input 1: type=input: f, Hz
Return 1: bark, bark coefficient

entry.name: bark2hzApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of Bark coefficients to Hz
Input 1: type=input: b, bark coefficient
Return 1: frequency, Hz

entry.name: hz2melApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of Hz to Mel coefficients
Input 1: type=input: f, Hz
Return 1: mel, mel coefficient

entry.name: mel2hzApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of Mel coefficients to Hz
Input 1: type=input: m, mel coefficient
Return 1: frequency, Hz

entry.name: c2pApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'cartopol()'
Input 1: type=input: real, cartesian
Input 2: type=input: imag, cartesian
Return 1: alpha, polar
Return 2: theta, polar

entry.name: p2cApprox()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'poltocar()'
Input 1: type=input: alpha, polar
Input 2: type=input: theta, polar
Return 1: real, cartesian
Return 2: imag, cartesian

entry.name: p2cApproxParam()
entry.description:
Approximation of 'poltocar()' suitable for Param rate (keep out of while loop)
Input 1: type=input: alpha, polar
Input 2: type=input: theta, polar
Return 1: real, cartesian
Return 2: imag, cartesian

entry.name: p2cApproxQuart()
entry.description:
Approximation of one cosine quarter of 'poltocar()'
Input 1: type=input: alpha, polar
Input 2: type=input: theta, polar
Return 1: real, multiplier 1
Return 2: imag, multiplier 2

entry.name: eviLog1p()
entry.description:
Not an approximation, full range implementation of 'log1p()'
Input 1: type=input: value, float
Return 1: log1p, library log(1 + x)

entry.name: Li2Approx()
entry.description:
Approximation of real dilogarithm mathrm{Li}_2(x), Alexander Voigt, @license GPL v3
Input 1: type=input: x, real argument
Return 1: Li2, mathrm{Li}_2(x)
